questions.e: Bayanau (adverb) mainly adds information about the aikatau (verb): how, when or where the action happens. Describing a noun is the job of sifa.

questions.e: Sifa (adjective) gives more information about a suna (noun), describing its quality, colour, size and so on, e.g. 'mota shud'iya' (a blue car).

Wannan misali ne na jimla

questions.s: Wace jimla ce ba ta d'auke da sifa?

questions.s: Wace jimla ce ke dauke da bayanau?

questions.s: Gano kalmar bayanau.

questions.e: Gambo is a birth-circumstance name given to a child born right after twins, not a name chosen at the naming ceremony (sunan yanka) like Audu.
questions.s: Wanne ne ba sunan yanka ba?

questions.s: 'Marin shi aka yi yau da rana. Wakilin suna a wannan jimla shi ne

Headmaster.

questions.s: Fassara wadannan: Students' Union.

questions.s: Fassara wadannan: They bought a new umbrella. Sun..........................lema.

questions.e: 'I am thirsty' in Hausa is 'Ina jin kishirwa'. Yunwa means hunger, so the keyed option means 'I am hungry', and the others mean sleepy, dizzy and tired. None of the options fits.
questions.s: Fassara wadannan: I am thirsty.

questions.e: Malalaci (lazy man), mayaudari (cheat) and malalaciya (lazy woman) are all describing words formed as adjectives, giving three (uku) sifa in the sentence.
questions.s:
Da malalaci da mayaudari duk malalaciya ce uwarsu. Kalmomin sifa nawa ne a cikin
wannan jimla?

questions.e: Nawa (mine) is the possessive pronoun: 'Littafin nawa ne' means 'The book is mine'. Su, shi and ka are not possessive forms here.
questions.s: "Littafin ______ne." Wace kalma ce take nuna mallaka?

questions.e: Bakake masu murya are voiced consonants, produced with vibration of the vocal cords, i.e. letters that carry voice (sauti), such as /b/, /d/ and /g/.
questions.s: Ma'anar bakake masu murya ita ce -
o: Haruffan guda biyu a wuri ɗaya
Haruffan da ba sa da sauti

questions.e: Mu (we) is the subject pronoun showing who performs the action of going (tafi); gida is the destination.
questions.s: A jimla "Mu tafi gida", wace kalma ce take nuna mai aiwatar da aiki?

questions.e: 'In Da So Da Kauna' is a romance novel; as its title (so and kauna both mean love) suggests, its main theme is soyayya (love).
questions.s: Wane jigo ne ya fi fitowa a cikin In Da So Da Kauna?

questions.e: 'Yarinya mai kyau' (a beautiful girl) is the full noun phrase: the noun yarinya with its modifier 'mai kyau'. Ce is only the copula.
questions.s: "Yarinya mai kyau ce." Wace ce jimla mai suna?

questions.e: 'Ya kamata kowa ya yi aiki tukuru' (Everyone should work hard) urges good conduct, so it expresses advice (shawara ko nasiha).
questions.s: "Ya kamata kowa ya yi aiki tukuru." Wannan jimla na nuna -

questions.e: Su (they) is the plural pronoun. Ta, shi and ya all refer to one person (singular).
questions.s: Wace kalma ke nuna jam'in magana?

questions.e: Repetition (maimaitawa) is the most common device in Hausa songs, used for emphasis and rhythm, often in refrains.
questions.s: Wanne salo ne ya fi yawa a cikin wakokin Hausa?

questions.e: Gajiya means tiredness or fatigue, closest to kasala (weariness/sluggishness). Natsuwa is calmness and jin dad'i is enjoyment.
questions.s: Ma'anar kalmar gajiya ita ce -

questions.e: 'Kada ka yi magana' (Don't talk) gives a command (a negative one), so it is jimlar umarni (imperative sentence).
questions.s: "Kada ka yi magana." Wane irin jimla ce wannan?

questions.e: 'Yara sun zo' (The children have come) is complete as it stands; the other options add words that make the sentence ungrammatical.
questions.s: Wanne ne ya dace da "Yara sun ... "?

questions.e: Hausa is written with five vowel letters (a, e, i, o, u), each of which can be short or long. Nine is not a standard count of Hausa vowels. The correct option is B.
questions.s: Haruffan murya (vowel sounds) a harshen Hausa nawa ne?

questions.e: 'Ina son karatu' (I love studying) is the natural complete sentence; karatu is an activity one can love doing.
questions.s: "Ina son________" Wacce kalma za ta cika gibin?

questions.e: British missionaries and colonial officials developed the modern Roman-letter Hausa writing system (boko), replacing reliance on Ajami.
questions.s: Wa ne ya taka rawa wajen kirkira tsarin rubutun Hausa na zamani?

questions.e: 'Ali ya sayi keke' has one subject, one verb and one object, so it is a simple sentence (jimla mai sauki).
questions.s: "Ali ya sayi keke." Wace irin jimla ce wannan?

questions.e: 'In Allah ya so' (if God wills) sets a condition on the action, so it is a conditional expression (kalmar sharad'i), signalled by 'in' (if).
questions.s: "Zan je makaranta gobe in Allah ya so." Me "in Allah ya so" ke nufi?

questions.e: 'Hannu daya ba ya d'aukar jinka' (one hand cannot lift a roof thatch) means no one can succeed alone; cooperation is needed.
questions.s: Ma'anar karin magana "Hannu daya baya daukar jinka" ita ce -
o: Ba a iya cin nasara kai kaɗai
Ba a iya daukar kaya da hannu guda

questions.e: The verb phrase 'ba su da komai' (they have nothing) requires the plural subject su (they) to agree with it.
questions.s: "Ina da kudi amma_______ba su da komai."

questions.e: Kan marks habitual action: 'Sukan zuwa kasuwa' means 'They usually go to market'. Ka and na do not agree with the subject su.
questions.s: Su_______zuwa kasuwa." Wace kalma ta dace?

questions.e: Karatu (reading/study) is directly linked to ilimi (knowledge/education); food, sleep and money are not.
questions.s: Wace kalma ce ke da alaka da ilimi?

questions.e: Hausa proverbs are short and simple in form but deep in meaning (sauki da zurfi), not long- winded or meaningless.
questions.s: Wane salo ne ya fi dacewa da karin magana a Hausance?

questions.e: Gida (home) and d'aki (room) are closely related, since a room is part of a home. The other pairs are opposites or unrelated places.
questions.s: Wadanne daga cikin wadannan kalmomi ne masu ma'anar kusanci?

questions.e: Cin hanci (bribery) is an act of injustice and dishonesty. Tausayi (compassion) and gaskiya (truth) are good qualities.
questions.s: Kalmar da ke nuni da halin rashin adalci ita ce -

questions.e: In 'Ina son karatu sosai', karatu is the thing that is liked, the object of son, so it acts as a suna (noun).
questions.s: Wane nau'i ne kalmar *karatu* take a jumla: *Ina son karatu sosai *?

questions.e: Kofa is written ƙofa with the hooked ƙ, an ejective (emphatic) consonant. Baki, gida and fari have plain consonants.
questions.s: Wace kalma ce ke ɗauke da harafi mai ƙarfi (emphatic)?

questions.e: The proverb gently mocks the hare, which is fast but fearful, so it teaches a lesson while amusing (fadakarwa da ban dariya).
questions.s:
Wane yanayi ne ke cikin karin magana "Zomo ya fi barewa da gudu, sai dai ya fi ta jin
tsoro"?

questions.e: Per the passage, Aliyu wants traditional crafts revived to strengthen the economy (bunkasa tattalin arziki).
questions.s: Me ya sa Aliyu ke ganin ya kamata a dawo da sana'o'in gargajiya?
o: Don a koyar da su a makaranta

questions.e: 'A filin makaranta' tells where the playing takes place, so filin makaranta (the school field) is the place expression.
questions.s: Wace kalma ce ke nuna wurin da abin ke faruwa a jimla: 'Yara suna wasa a filin makaranta'?

questions.e: 'Hannu daya ba ya d'aukar jinka' teaches that people should help one another (a taimaka wa juna) because one hand alone cannot lift a load.
questions.s: Ma'anar karin magana 'Hannu daya baya daukar jinka' ita ce -

questions.e: Karya (lying) is a kind of behaviour or character trait (halayya), and a bad one; it is not work or food.
questions.s: Wane yanayi ne kalmar *karya* ke nuni da shi?

questions.e: Ka'idar sarrafa kalmomi (morphology) covers how words change form, e.g. by adding affixes for plurals or derived words.
questions.s: Wace ka'ida ce ke sa kalmomi su sauya fasali a cikin nahawun Hausa?

questions.e: The device that repeats lines or words for emphasis is salo na maimaitawa (repetition).
questions.s: Wani tsarin waƙa ke nuna maimaitawa don jaddada magana?

questions.e: 'Mun kammala aikin kafin yamma' (We finished the work before evening) uses the completed form mun, so it shows past/completed action.
questions.s: Jimlar 'Mun kammala aikin kafin yamma' tana nuni da -

questions.e: Aminu Ala's songs are known chiefly for warning and moral advice (gargad'i da nasiha) to society.
questions.s: Wane salo ne ya fi fitowa a cikin wakokin Aminu Ala?

questions.e: Gudu (running) names the action the boy performed, so it is the action word (sunan aiki). Yaro is the subject and ya the pronoun.
questions.s: Wace kalma ce ke aiki a matsayin 'sunan aiki' a cikin jimlar: 'Yaro ya gudu'?

questions.e: Per the passage, Amina did not return to school after the holiday because she lacked the money (ba ta da kud'in komawa).
questions.s: Me yasa Amina ta ki komawa makaranta bayan hutu?
o: Saboda tana da aiki a gida
Saboda ta yi fushi da malamai
Saboda ba ta da kudin komawa

questions.e: 'Ruwa ba ya tsami banza' (water does not go sour for nothing) means everything has a cause (komai yana da dalili).
questions.s: Menene manufar karin magana: *Ruwa baya tsami banza *?

questions.e: The proverb uses images of east and west to compare situations, so the key classes it as a karin magana mai kwatanci (comparative proverb).
questions.s: Wane nau'in karin magana ne: *Gabas ta gabas, yamma bata hana ta *?

questions.e: 'Komai nisan jifa kasa zai sauka' (however far a stone is thrown, it will land) warns that every act or situation has an end, so it is used for gargad'i (warning).
questions.s: A wane hali ne ake amfani da karin magana: *Komai nisan jifa kasa zai sauka *?

questions.e: Kasuwa (market) is a place one goes to; dawo, zauna and tafi are verbs, not places.
questions.s: Wace kalma ce ke nuni da wurin da ake zuwa?

questions.e: Ya is a pronoun (he), not a noun, while Ali and mota are nouns. Sayi is also not a noun (it is a verb), but the key focuses on the pronoun.
questions.s: Wace kalma ce ba suna ba ce a jumlar nan: *Ali ya sayi sabuwar mota *?

questions.e: Madalla is an expression of praise and approval (yabo), like 'excellent!' It is not blame (zargi) or remembering (tuna).
questions.s: Kalmar *madalla* tana nufin:

questions.e: The key treats dad'i (pleasantness/sweetness) as a sifa, a quality word describing how something is, rather than an action.
questions.s: Wane bangare na harshe ne kalmar *dadi *?

questions.e: Gobe (tomorrow) tells when the going will happen, so it is the time word; zan marks future and tafi is the verb.
questions.s: Wace kalma ce ke nuna lokaci a jumlar nan: *Zan tafi gobe *?

questions.e: Tsangwama means harassment or maltreatment, closest to cin zarafi (abuse). Girman kai is pride and kiyayya is hatred.
questions.s: Menene ma'anar 'tsangwama' a cikin Hausa?

Jam'in

questions.s: A tsarin rubutun insha'i, "Ginshiki" ya kunshi
